SELECT s.id AS sku_id, s.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.origin, s.weight, s.grind_type, s.price, s.stock, s.version FROM coffee_sku s JOIN coffee_product p ON s.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0
AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.origin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.weight LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY s.stock ASC, s.id ASC
